{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module MobileBackend.Auth where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Aeson
import GHC.Generics
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Crypto.MAC.HMAC as HMAC
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA
import Data.Word (Word8, Word64)
import Data.Bits (xor, (.|.))

-- Cross-service authentication for mobile backend
-- Services: UserService, PaymentService, AdminService

data ServiceToken = ServiceToken
  { stUserId    :: Text
  , stRole      :: Role
  , stIssuedAt  :: Integer
  , stExpiresAt :: Integer
  , stIssuer    :: Text
  , stAudience  :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

data Role = User | Moderator | Admin | ServiceAccount
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord, Generic)

instance FromJSON Role
instance ToJSON Role
instance FromJSON ServiceToken
instance ToJSON ServiceToken

data AuthRequest = AuthRequest
  { arToken     :: Text
  , arTargetSvc :: Text
  , arAction    :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON AuthRequest
instance ToJSON AuthRequest

-- Service-to-service shared secrets (in production, from vault)
serviceSecrets :: [(Text, ByteString)]
serviceSecrets =
  [ ("user-service", "sk_user_a8f3e2b1c4d5")
  , ("payment-service", "sk_pay_7e6d5c4b3a29")
  , ("admin-service", "sk_admin_1f2e3d4c5b6a")
  ]

-- Compute HMAC for token verification
computeHMAC :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
computeHMAC secret payload =
  let mac = HMAC.hmac secret payload :: HMAC.HMAC H.SHA256
  in BA.convert mac

-- Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
constantTimeCompare :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = (== 0) $ foldl' orDiff (0 :: Word64) $
      zipWith xor (BS.unpack a) (BS.unpack b)
  where
    orDiff acc w = acc .|. fromIntegral w

-- Verify token signature from issuing service
verifyTokenSignature :: Text -> ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
verifyTokenSignature issuer tokenPayload providedSig =
  case lookup issuer serviceSecrets of
    Nothing     -> False
    Just secret -> constantTimeCompare (computeHMAC secret tokenPayload) providedSig

-- Role elevation rules for cross-service calls
-- When a service authenticates on behalf of a user, the effective role
-- may be elevated based on the calling service's trust level
resolveEffectiveRole :: Text -> Text -> Role -> Role
resolveEffectiveRole sourceService targetService baseRole =
  case (sourceService, targetService) of
    -- Admin service can elevate roles when calling other services
    ("admin-service", _) -> promoteRole baseRole
    -- Payment service gets elevated access to user service for refunds
    ("payment-service", "user-service") -> promoteRole baseRole
    -- All other cross-service calls preserve the base role
    _ -> baseRole

-- Promote a role by one level
promoteRole :: Role -> Role
promoteRole User = Moderator
promoteRole Moderator = Admin
promoteRole Admin = Admin
promoteRole ServiceAccount = ServiceAccount

-- Main authorization check for incoming cross-service requests
authorizeRequest :: AuthRequest -> ServiceToken -> IO (Either Text ServiceToken)
authorizeRequest req token = do
  now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime
  let checks = runAuthChecks now req token
  case checks of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right effectiveToken -> return $ Right effectiveToken

-- Run all authorization checks and return effective token
runAuthChecks :: Integer -> AuthRequest -> ServiceToken -> Either Text ServiceToken
runAuthChecks now req token = do
  -- Check token expiration
  if stExpiresAt token < now
    then Left "Token expired"
    else Right ()
  -- Check audience matches target
  if stAudience token /= arTargetSvc req
    then Left "Audience mismatch"
    else Right ()
  -- Resolve effective role based on cross-service trust
  let effectiveRole = resolveEffectiveRole (stIssuer token) (arTargetSvc req) (stRole token)
  -- Check if effective role is sufficient for the action
  let requiredRole = actionRequiredRole (arAction req)
  if effectiveRole < requiredRole
    then Left "Insufficient privileges"
    else Right token { stRole = effectiveRole }

-- Map actions to required roles
actionRequiredRole :: Text -> Role
actionRequiredRole action
  | T.isPrefixOf "admin." action = Admin
  | T.isPrefixOf "mod." action   = Moderator
  | T.isPrefixOf "pay." action   = Moderator
  | otherwise                     = User

-- Token refresh endpoint - allows extending token lifetime
-- Cross-service tokens can be refreshed if the original issuer trusts the target
refreshToken :: ServiceToken -> Text -> IO (Either Text ServiceToken)
refreshToken token requestingService = do
  now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime
  -- Validate the token is still within grace period (5 min after expiry)
  if stExpiresAt token + 300 < now
    then return $ Left "Token beyond refresh grace period"
    else do
      -- On refresh, preserve the original role - do NOT re-resolve
      -- Re-resolving would allow privilege escalation via service impersonation
      let newToken = token
            { stExpiresAt = now + 3600
            , stIssuedAt = now
            }
      return $ Right newToken
